verdict.rationale: LangGraph's GitHub docs explicitly promote 'Debugging with LangSmith' offering visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide runtime metrics — directly matching the story of tracing LLM/tool calls in an observability UI. However, this capability relies on the separate LangSmith product rather than being a built-in LangGraph feature, and community feedback notes debugging complexity with parallelism and incomplete streaming implementations, so full first-party built-in tracing isn't clearly demonstrated.
